superseded_record_text.notes: Published Vinet fit of Re compression on Yokoo et al. (2009) platinum pressure scale. Figure 10 distinguishes conventional-DAC RP01 and ds-DAC Micro17 points; exact fit-row membership and weights are not specified. RP01 used silica glass and a tungsten gasket; Micro17 used glycerin and direct anvil loading. Parenthetical errors are preserved without assuming their confidence level or covariance. V0 is fixed, with no fabricated zero uncertainty. At the rounded reported V=18.65 A^3, the printed parameters give 461.56 GPa versus the reported 464 GPa; the difference is compatible with coefficient rounding. This does not independently refit the original observations. A subsequent Figure 10 vector refit of the 26 RP01 Yokoo-Pt points gives K0=357.19 GPa and K0_prime=4.83483, both within the printed errors. Selecting RP01 and unweighted pressure residuals is a documented reconstruction: adding Micro17 or changing residual coordinates changes the optimum; see the dedicated audit.
validity_notes: Approximate Yokoo-Pt pressure coverage read from Figure 10, not exact tabulated endpoints. The text reports RP01 to 280 GPa on the lower pressure scale; the Yokoo-Pt reduction reaches about 310 GPa.
Room temperature represented as 300 K; no exact temperature or thermal coefficients are reported.
The approximately 464 GPa Micro16 result is an extrapolation beyond the Re-Pt co-compression fit.

superseded_record_text.label: Zha et al. (2004), Table III BM3 plus logarithmic thermal pressure
superseded_record_text.notes: Published continuous Equation (6), Table III branch, not the author-preferred fixed-V0 Table IV/Table V isotherms. All eight Table IIb observations determine linear isochore slopes; their unweighted regression against ln(Va/V) reproduces both Table III coefficients to 0.05%. The model gives pressure RMS 0.4085 GPa against printed rows. No coefficient uncertainties or covariance are published. Experiments cover only 6.41-8.47 GPa and 1380.3-1914.5 K, with V>Va; application to 20% compression and 3000 K is a large source extrapolation. Table III gives Kprime=4.5; the apparent prose 4.53 is 4.5 followed by superscript citation 3. The source Va differs from the existing structural cell. Table IV fixed-V0 and free branches and all Table V outputs are bundled separately; no interpolation or substitution for Equation (6) is implied. The cited Anderson gold calibration is partially resolved: substituting the explicit Au reference volume in the related catalog model leaves discrepancies up to 0.318 GPa, which are documented separately.
